parsed.notes:
What We’re Looking For sets required qualifications; Bonus Points For makes its entries optional.
Cloud providers are examples for a single cloud-environment ask and form alternative group 1. Spark, Hive, and Redshift are explicitly joined by 'and', so they are not grouped.
NLP and spaCy map to the same taxonomy ID. The separately named broad NLP requirement remains outside an alternative group; Transformers alone cannot form a group.
Generative AI and LLMs collapse to the same taxonomy ID.
Deploying data science solutions is provisionally mapped to AI deployment, although model deployment is not explicitly stated in the qualifications.
Applying AI-enabled approaches is provisionally mapped to AI/ML; it is broader than AI coding tools and does not explicitly ask for coding assistants.
Responsible AI principles are treated as a technical practice, not as data privacy or LLM guardrails. Data engineering, generic ML libraries, Hive, Redshift, and competition participation have no fitting taxonomy entry.
Technologies and practices appearing only in responsibilities are excluded. Financial-services knowledge, leadership, mentoring, and communication are not skill criteria under this taxonomy.
